articles.summary: The American Lawyer reports on Burford Capital's record 2023 results. CEO Christopher Bogart is quoted: "'We did more than a billion dollars in new business, more than we’ve ever done. What that is showing is the level of demand and market interest for these solutions,' said Burford CEO Christopher Bogart. 'Now that the pandemic is fully behind us and the courts are fully open, we have a $7 billion litigation portfolio.'"
articles.title: The American Lawyer reports on Burford's record 2023 results

articles.summary: Lawdragon has named 17 Burford employees to its list of the 100 Global Leaders in Legal Finance for 2024, making it the most represented company in the rankings.
articles.title: Lawdragon recognizes Burford on Lawdragon's list of 100 Global Leaders in Litigation Finance

articles.summary: Law360 writes how Burford has seen "revenues leap in 'extraordinary year.'" The article begins: "Burford Capital announced Thursday that revenues in its standalone business had almost quadrupled in 2023 to nearly $1 billion as it saw high volumes of cases reach a conclusion in the aftermath of the pandemic."
articles.title: Law360 on Burford's "'extraordinary year'"

articles.summary: The American Lawyer reports on Burford's hiring of Carrie Tendler. The article states: "Burford Capital, the world's largest publicly traded litigation funder, is building up its team of lawyers dedicated to enforcing rulings in which foreign assets are at stake."
articles.title: The American Lawyer reports on Burford's hiring of Carrie Tendler

articles.summary: Evan Meyerson speaks with The National Law Journal about the increase in interest to build out contingency practices at law firms. “‘It’s fair to say we’ve seen a noticeable increase in interest in building out plaintiff side practices among the more traditional defense-oriented law firms,’ said Evan Meyerson, director at Burford Capital, in an interview. ‘There’s a growing desire to become—and comfort level with becoming—truly the one-stop shop for their institutional clients.’”
articles.title: Evan Meyerson speaks about law firm growth in contingency practices

articles.summary: Eric Carlson speaks with IAM as a legal expert in relation to the Apple-Masimo dispute. “‘People in the background may be productively working on settlement discussions,’ [Carlson] said. ‘A settlement is possible at any moment in these big sprawling disputes.’”
articles.title: Eric Carlson speaks with IAM about the Apple-Masimo dispute

articles.summary: Burford CEO Christopher Bogart appears on John Quinn's Podcast, "Law, disrupted,” for an episode entitled "AI and Data Science in Litigation Finance." Bogart and Quinn discuss the use of AI and data science in legal finance decisions and Bogart explains how advances in data science have allowed funders to improve funding decisions.
articles.title: Christopher Bogart on John Quinn's podcast to discuss AI and data science in legal finance
